answer: Rotating challenge-response with geological anisotropy. Each identity must answer, within one pulse window, a challenge derived from local karst hydrology data that changes with rainfall and is not published. Answers are scored against the simulator’s hidden state, so copied answers fail. Registration requires solving a fresh quartz-oscillator timing puzzle whose nonce depends on the prior challenge, making replay impossible. An attacker pays one live sensor reading and one timing-circuit run per identity per pulse, and any duplicate answer is rejected.
